description: Adds the CloudForge getting-started walkthrough to the Welcome page.
walkthrough.title: Get started with CloudForge
walkthrough.description: Open your cloud infrastructure, check the local CloudForge service, and set up your workspace.
step.openWorkspace.title: Open a CloudForge workspace
step.openWorkspace.description:
Choose a CloudForge project or a Terraform folder. CloudForge reads it without changing your files.
[Open Workspace](command:cloudforge.openWorkspace)
step.service.title: Check the CloudForge service
step.service.description:
CloudForge runs a local service for guarded file access and Terraform analysis. Check that it started and which version is running.
[Show Service Status](command:cloudforge.showProofStatus)
step.theme.title: Choose your theme
step.theme.description:
CloudForge uses Tokyo Night by default, and Tokyo Night Light when your system uses light mode.
[Browse Color Themes](command:workbench.action.selectTheme)
step.terminal.title: Use the terminal for your cloud tools
step.terminal.description:
Run your own scripts and cloud CLIs in the integrated terminal. CloudForge never runs them for you without asking.
[Open Terminal](command:workbench.action.terminal.new)
